column1: ## Location : Location of variant in standard coordinate format (chr:start or chr:start-end)
## Allele : The variant allele used to calculate the consequence
## IMPACT : Subjective impact classification of consequence type
## ClinVar_CLNSIG : Aggregate germline classification for this single variant; multiple values are separated by a vertical bar. CLNSIG field from [PATH]/clinvar.vcf.gz
## ClinVar_CLNREVSTAT : ClinVar review status of germline classification for the Variation ID. CLNREVSTAT field from [PATH]/clinvar.vcf.gz
## ClinVar_CLNDN : ClinVar's preferred disease name for the concept specified by disease identifiers in CLNDISDB. CLNDN field from [PATH]/clinvar.vcf.gz
## BIOTYPE : Biotype of transcript or regulatory feature

## VEP command-line: vep --assembly GRCh38 --biotype --cache --custom file=[PATH]/clinvar.vcf.gz,short_name=ClinVar,format=vcf,type=exact,coords=0,fields=CLNSIG%CLNREVSTAT%CLNDN --database 0 --dir_cache [PATH]/vep_cache --dir_plugins /plugins --fields Uploaded_variation,Location,Allele,SYMBOL,Consequence,IMPACT,SIFT,PolyPhen,ClinVar_CLNSIG,ClinVar_CLNREVSTAT,ClinVar_CLNDN,VARIANT_CLASS,BIOTYPE --force_overwrite --format vcf --input_file [PATH]/somatic.filtered.PASS.vcf.gz --offline --output_file [PATH]/somatic.filtered.PASS.vep.clinvar.tsv --pick --polyphen b --sift b --symbol --tab --variant_class
